knowledge.title: What Latchkey sells
knowledge.text: Latchkey rewrites the words on B2B websites and sales decks for industrial and hardware companies. A project covers positioning, the homepage, the product pages and the first sales deck, in four weeks, from interviews with three customers and the founders.

knowledge.title: How a project runs
knowledge.text: Week 1 customer interviews. Week 2 positioning on one page. Week 3 page copy in a shared doc with two rounds of edits. Week 4 the sales deck and handover. One writer and one editor per project.

knowledge.title: How we write
knowledge.text: Plain words. Short sentences. Name the machine, the part and the number. No adjective an engineer would not use about their own work.

site.title: Harrowgate Robotics: palletizing and end-of-line automation
site.description: Harrowgate builds robotic palletizers and end-of-line automation for food and beverage plants.
site.markdown:
# Next-generation palletizing solutions that empower manufacturers to optimize throughput and reduce downtime.

## HX Series palletizer
Flexible, scalable, and designed for the demands of modern production environments, the HX Series sets a new standard in robotic palletizing. Up to 40 cases per minute. Pattern changeover in under 10 minutes from the panel. Mixed-case palletizing on one line.

## LineSight
Real-time visibility into end-of-line performance, powered by advanced analytics. See every stop and its cause, on the floor or on your phone.

## Customers
Trusted by leading food and beverage manufacturers across North America.

## Service
24/7 support. Parts dispatched within 48 hours. Field technicians in 14 states.

data.headline: Three lines of your site, rewritten the way a plant manager reads them
data.intro: Hi Priya, nobody at Harrowgate asked for this. I read your homepage the way a plant manager would and rewrote the three lines they hit first. Your service section gave me the voice: parts within 48 hours is a sentence that sells.
data.kind: Three rewritten lines from your site
data.site_note: The homepage headline, the HX Series and LineSight sections, and the service numbers at the bottom of the page.

blocks.label: Rewrite 1
blocks.title: The homepage headline
blocks.body: Next-generation and empower are on every palletizer site, so a plant manager reads past them. The two numbers that decide a visit are further down your own page: 40 cases a minute and a changeover under 10 minutes. The headline should carry them.
blocks.before: Next-generation palletizing solutions that empower manufacturers to optimize throughput and reduce downtime.
blocks.after: Palletizing robots for food and beverage lines. Up to 40 cases a minute, and a new pattern in under 10 minutes.

blocks.label: Rewrite 2
blocks.title: The HX Series paragraph
blocks.body: The first sentence says nothing a buyer can check. The facts that follow it are good, so the rewrite keeps them and drops the adjectives. Mixed cases on one line is the detail a plant with many SKUs is looking for, so it goes first.
blocks.before: Flexible, scalable, and designed for the demands of modern production environments, the HX Series sets a new standard in robotic palletizing.
blocks.after: The HX Series palletizes mixed cases on one line, up to 40 a minute. Change the pattern from the panel and run again in under 10 minutes.

blocks.label: Rewrite 3
blocks.title: The LineSight paragraph
blocks.body: Real-time visibility and advanced analytics describe a category, not your product. Your second sentence already says what it does. The rewrite leads with that and names who looks at it, because a line supervisor and a plant manager open it for different reasons.
blocks.before: Real-time visibility into end-of-line performance, powered by advanced analytics. See every stop and its cause, on the floor or on your phone.
blocks.after: LineSight shows every stop on the line and what caused it. The supervisor sees it on the floor, and you see it on your phone.

blocks.label: Left as is
blocks.title: What we would not touch yet
blocks.body: Two parts of the page are already doing their job, or need something a rewrite cannot give them.

items.name: The service section
items.note: 24/7 support, parts within 48 hours, technicians in 14 states. Specific and short. Keep it, and move it higher up the page.

items.name: The customers section
items.note: Trusted by leading manufacturers names nobody. It needs customer interviews first, not new words.

data.full_intro: These three lines are the top of one page. The full project covers the site and the first sales deck in four weeks.

full.title: Three customer interviews

full.title: Homepage, HX Series and LineSight pages

data.closing: If these lines read right to you, reply and I will send the rest of the homepage done the same way. If they are off, tell me which word you would never say to a customer and I will redo them.
